environment.TOMI_CORE_URL: Set to the configured core service origin

secret_requirements: Distinct gateway and adapter bearer tokens; core bearer must match core internal auth; no provider keys

writable_paths.purpose: Private internal gateway config and SQLite session state; replica-local. Persistent volume needed only if sessions must survive revisions.
Empty isolated workspace; bootstrap and context injection disabled

storage_constraint: Do not run concurrent gateways against shared SQLite files.
startup: CMD node scripts/start-all.mjs starts gateway and adapter; variables may be injected without an image .env file
shutdown: SIGTERM forwarded to both children, bounded to ten seconds; local container stop verified
